BlogIdentidad.title: From Principia Mathematica to Software Engineering: The Logic Behind LogikaMobile
BlogIdentidad.subtitle: Why we leave no room for assumptions in software development.
BlogIdentidad.p_1_1: In the early 20th century, mathematicians Alfred North Whitehead and Bertrand Russell undertook a monumental work: Principia Mathematica. Their ambition was to prove that absolutely all mathematical truths could be derived from a closed and finite set of logical axioms. The ultimate goal was to eradicate paradoxes, contradictions, and assumptions from mathematics to turn it into an exact and infallible science.
BlogIdentidad.p_1_2: At LogikaMobile, we operate under this same foundational rigor. Software development based on assumptions, wild guesses, and ambiguous requirements is not engineering, it's a leap of faith. For us, a system based on structured logic, clear business rules, and precise flowcharts is a mathematical certainty.
BlogIdentidad.p_2_1: The symbolic logic that Principia helped consolidate laid the conceptual foundations so that, years later, the Universal Turing Machine and Boolean algebra could exist. The abstract postulates of "true" and "false" left the paper to become logical gates capable of physically processing information.
BlogIdentidad.p_2_2: Modern software is not magic; it's applied pure logic. Whether we are talking about a cluster of cloud servers, a complex web browser, or a next-generation mobile device, the code must be an unbreakable chain of deterministic instructions. Given the same inputs, the system must always return the same outputs. It is this guiding principle that inspires our technical and ethical manifesto.
BlogIdentidad.p_3_1: Dogma and ambiguity are the great enemies of stability. That's why our engineering is strictly based on strongly typed languages and architectures. Design errors and flaws must be resolved at compile time through rigid and relentless logic, and never blow up at runtime in front of the final user.
BlogIdentidad.p_3_2: Under the precepts of Clean Architecture, we determine that business logic —the true brain of your company— must remain isolated from infrastructure, like the database or the user interface. This guarantees that the operational core of the software is immutable and highly testable, remaining robust regardless of whether you decide to change the presentation technology tomorrow.
BlogIdentidad.p_4_1: Just as Principia Mathematica standardized modern mathematical rigor, at LogikaMobile we standardize the rigor of technological deployment. We do not upload code to production manually or by crossing our fingers. We use rigorous automated testing and Continuous Integration and Deployment pipelines to ensure that the transition of code, from the repository to the final product, is completely free of human errors.
BlogIdentidad.cta: Is your current architecture an assumption or a proven theorem? Let's refactor your system and turn doubt into mathematical certainty.

BlogManifiesto.title: The Turing Manifesto: Absolute Inclusion and the "Built to Fail" Philosophy
BlogManifiesto.subtitle: What Alan Turing taught us about technical brilliance and stress testing.
BlogManifiesto.h2_1: The historical legacy and Absolute Inclusion
BlogManifiesto.p_1_1: Alan Turing is one of the most brilliant minds to have walked this world. He not only formalized the foundational concepts of algorithm and computation with his Turing Machine model, but his intellect literally saved millions of lives by successfully deciphering the Enigma machine codes during World War II. However, his brilliance was cruelly punished due to his sexual orientation, leading to a tragic end driven by the dogma, prejudice, and brutal intolerance of his time.
BlogManifiesto.p_1_2: At LogikaMobile we have an unwavering stance on this: computation is, in its purest essence, the ultimate equalizer. A compiler absolutely does not care about the gender, sexual orientation, race, identity, or social class of whoever writes the code; the compiler only cares that the logic is exact, efficient, and elegant. Therefore, we are a radically inclusive company. We firmly believe that talent and technical brilliance only flourish in environments where dogma is eliminated and human capacity is prioritized.
BlogManifiesto.h2_2: The Turing Test as the ultimate audit
BlogManifiesto.p_2_1: The famous "Imitation Game" was originally designed to evaluate whether a machine could exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from that of a human. But if we analyze the core of this exercise, the Turing Test is actually an adversarial stress test: the interrogator is actively looking for the flaw, trying to find the crack in the logical chain of the system, looking for that subtle error that gives the machine away.
BlogManifiesto.link_identidad: the logical chain of the system
BlogManifiesto.p_2_2: In traditional software engineering, tests are usually done simply to prove that the code "works". At LogikaMobile we consider this to be a highly dangerous confirmation bias. We have adopted the philosophy of the Turing interrogator.
BlogManifiesto.h2_3: "Built to Fail" - Our Quality Assurance Culture
BlogManifiesto.p_3_1: Our Quality Assurance environments and our automated test suites are designed under a non-negotiable premise: "Built to Fail". We don't write tests to validate the happy path; we write tests designed with the almost malicious intent of breaking the system.
BlogManifiesto.p_3_2: How do we do it? We inject null data, we saturate network requests through concurrent loads, we simulate catastrophic database crashes, and we interrupt critical transactional flows halfway through the process. If the software manages to survive this ruthless scrutiny without corrupting data or compromising security, then —and only then— is it worthy of going into production.
BlogManifiesto.p_4_1: Human diversity gives us the best minds; technical rigor gives us the best products. By applying the adversarial "Built to Fail" philosophy through methodologies like TDD and automated CI/CD pipelines, we guarantee that the worst scenarios and critical failures occur only on our closed test servers, and never in your company's live operation.
BlogManifiesto.h2_5: Real Code Auditing & Technical Debt Reduction
BlogManifiesto.p_5_1: Putting the 'Built to Fail' philosophy into practice means never waiting for a production outage to discover system weaknesses. In our preventive audits, we subject enterprise codebases to ruthless analysis: detecting memory leaks, N+1 SQL bottlenecks, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and architectural rot.
BlogManifiesto.p_5_2: We have reduced technical debt by up to 70% in legacy infrastructures, slashing response times of critical APIs from seconds to milliseconds and safeguarding business continuity before a flaw impacts revenue or brand reputation.
BlogManifiesto.cta: Would your current system fail a stress test? Let's talk about refactoring and scalable architecture.

LogikaFiskal.metadata_title: LogikaFiskal Suite | Three-Layer Fiscal Fortress & ISO 27001
LogikaFiskal.metadata_desc: Unified Fiscal Accounting SaaS Suite, SAT Bulk Extraction and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Cryptographic Vault. Modules: SeKurita, FisKalApi, and LogiKont.
LogikaFiskal.subtitle: Three-Layer Fiscal Fortress
LogikaFiskal.sub_description: Unified SaaS Fiscal Accounting Suite, Bulk SAT Extraction, and Cryptographic Vault compliant with the international ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard.
LogikaFiskal.section1_p1: Modern fiscal management in Mexico cannot rely on sluggish monolithic systems, fragile SAT connections, or vulnerable storage where electronic signatures remain exposed.
LogikaFiskal.section1_p2: LogikaFiskal is an enterprise platform engineered to resolve and automate Mexico's entire fiscal and accounting chain from end to end. It unifies bulk and deduplicated SAT extraction of CFDI 3.3 & 4.0 invoices, immutable cryptographic custody with streaming encryption and active RAM zeroing, and automated accounting in a multi-tenant ERP augmented by generative Artificial Intelligence.
LogikaFiskal.layer1_desc: Cross-cutting cybersecurity framework under the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard. Guards private keys via Envelope Encryption, streams data through 1 MB AEAD blocks (Google Tink), purges RAM secrets (MemoryWiper), and seals transactions in an immutable CEF ledger.
LogikaFiskal.layer1_role: Suite Cornerstone / Licensable as B2B SDK and Vault
LogikaFiskal.layer2_desc: High-concurrency asynchronous microservice for bulk SAT extraction. Combines official SOAP client with XMLDSig signing (FlowSAT), Playwright express bot with CIEC, 5004 anti-throttling cache (FlowBD), and ZIP streaming engine (DataMapper).
LogikaFiskal.layer2_role: Internal Engine / Licensable as Fiscal PaaS API for ERPs
LogikaFiskal.layer3_desc: Executive web interface (Next.js 16 + React 19) and Ktor accounting core with strict Schema-per-Tenant isolation in PostgreSQL, OIDC federated identity via Keycloak, HttpOnly JWE cookies, and multimodal bank reconciliation with Gemini Vertex AI.
LogikaFiskal.layer3_role: Flagship SaaS Product for CPA Firms and Enterprises
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_stack: Kotlin Core / KMP, Google Tink 1.7.0, Ktor, Redis, TypeScript
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_persistence: PostgreSQL, Redis (Rate Limiter), Encrypted Local WAL (Ports 8010, 3000)
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_security: Tink AEAD 1 MB Encryption, MemoryWiper (0x00), CEF Hash Chain, PIISanitizer
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_role: Suite Foundation / Licensable as B2B SDK and Vault
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_security: M2M Token (X-Service-Token), idEmpresa-RFC validation, Cloud KMS, XMLDSig
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_role: Internal Core / Licensable as Fiscal PaaS API for ERPs

LogikaFiskal.comp_row1_trad: Stored as plaintext on disk or standard DB; passwords exposed in system RAM.
LogikaFiskal.comp_row1_lf: SeKurita: Envelope Encryption (DEK/KEK) backed by Google Cloud KMS and instant RAM zeroing (0x00).
LogikaFiskal.comp_row2_trad: Frequent throttling (Error 5004) and memory crashes when decompressing large ZIP files.
LogikaFiskal.comp_row2_lf: FisKalApi: FlowBD anti-throttling cache, dual engine (SOAP 200k CFDI + Playwright Bot), and Zero-OOM streaming.
LogikaFiskal.comp_row3_trad: All customer data co-mingled in shared database tables.

LogikaFiskal.comp_row4_lf: LogiKont + AI: Direct PDF statement ingestion with gemini-1.5-flash and automated CFDI cross-referencing.
LogikaFiskal.section5_title: Technological Depth of the Three Modules
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_quote: "Before processing a single voucher, we shield the fiscal identity: your private keys are dual-encrypted in the cloud, destroyed from RAM after every signature, and leave an immutable audit trail."
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_quote: "We tame SAT intermittency and restrictions with a dual download engine, intelligent anti-throttling cache, and continuous CFDI streaming."
LogikaFiskal.logikont_quote: "Where cryptographic and fiscal power turns into executive elegance: isolated accounting per firm and automated AI bank reconciliation."
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_feat1_title: Fiscal Vault with Envelope Encryption (Google Cloud KMS)
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_feat1_desc: The vault_fiel table stores certificates (.cer), private keys (.key), and passwords encrypted with a random AES-256 data encryption key (DEK), wrapped by a master key (KEK) in Google Cloud KMS via KeyEncryptionProvider.
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_feat2_title: Google Tink Streaming AEAD Encryption (1 MB Segments)
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_feat2_desc: The SeKureStorage engine leverages AesGcmHkdfStreaming (AES-256-GCM + HKDF-SHA256) to resolve historical Java vulnerability JDK-8016249. It validates MAC authenticity block-by-block (1 MB) without memory overflow (Zero-OOM) and halts with IOException: Tag mismatch if a single byte is altered.
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_feat3_desc: Mitigates memory dump leaks (Heap Dumps) by immediately overwriting byte arrays in secretKey.encoded and FIEL passwords with binary zeros (0x00) within strict try-finally blocks.
LogikaFiskal.sekurita_feat4_desc: AuditLedgerEngine logs every security event in standard CEF format chained with SHA-256 hashes (triggers QuarantineException upon tampering). Additionally, PIISanitizer dynamically masks RFCs, CURPs, credit cards, phones, and emails across all logs.
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_feat1_title: Dual Extraction Engine (FlowSAT SOAP + Playwright Express Scraper)
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_feat1_desc: Implements all 4 official SAT WebService phases (Autentica, SolicitaDescarga, VerificaSolicitudDescarga, and DescargaMasiva) with XMLDSig SHA256withRSA signatures for batches up to 200,000 CFDIs. For urgent requests, it connects to a Python FastAPI microservice with Playwright for CIEC portal scraping.
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_feat2_desc: Intercepts redundant requests checking (rfc, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin, tipo_comprobante) in solicitud_descarga. Reuses active tokens and regulates polling windows to 15 minutes, preventing SAT errors 5004 and 5005.
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_feat3_desc: DataMapper processes massive ZIP files in continuous stream without full RAM buffering, indexes metadata into cfdi_metadata, and encrypts XMLs in Google Cloud Storage. Generates DIOT TXT layouts and Anexo 24 v1.3 XMLs (Chart of Accounts, Trial Balance, Journal Entries) signed with FIEL.
LogikaFiskal.fiskalapi_feat4_desc: ServiceAuthPlugin enforces the secret X-Service-Token (rejecting intruders with 401 Unauthorized), while GET /cfdi relationally verifies that id_empresa matches the requested RFC, preventing tenant data leaks with 403 Forbidden.
LogikaFiskal.logikont_feat1_desc: Built with Next.js 16.3.8 (App Router), React 19.2.8, Tailwind CSS v4, Shadcn/Radix UI, Zustand 5, and production obfuscation with javascript-obfuscator. Identity is federated via Keycloak 24.0.0 (OIDC / RBAC), and NextAuth.js v4 secures sessions in encrypted JWE cookies (HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure), eliminating localStorage.
LogikaFiskal.logikont_feat2_desc: TenantManager dynamically provisions a private PostgreSQL 15 schema (tenant_{uuid}) per firm with dedicated accounts, double-entry balanced policies (Debit/Credit), and invoices. Supports multi-firm operation over the same RFC using the compound index (organizacion_id, rfc).
LogikaFiskal.logikont_feat3_title: Multimodal Bank Reconciliation with Gemini Vertex AI
LogikaFiskal.logikont_feat3_desc: VertexAIService ingests monthly bank statement PDFs using gemini-1.5-flash, parses line items, and performs intelligent semantic and numerical fuzzy matching against outstanding CFDIs, providing match rationale and suggesting automatic journal entries.
LogikaFiskal.flow_step1_desc: LogiKont forwards certificates to FisKalApi; dual-encrypted with DEK/KEK in vault_fiel via Cloud KMS and MemoryWiper immediately clears RAM to zeros (0x00).
LogikaFiskal.flow_step2_desc: FlowSAT signs SOAP requests with XMLDSig (or runs Playwright), while FlowBD prevents duplicates and 5004 errors before receiving the ZIP.
LogikaFiskal.flow_step3_desc: DataMapper encrypts the ZIP on-the-fly with Tink Streaming AEAD (1 MB) to Cloud Storage and catalogs CFDIs into PostgreSQL 16.
LogikaFiskal.flow_step4_desc: LogiKont queries /cfdi authenticated with X-Service-Token and passes the relational idEmpresa <-> RFC validation.
LogikaFiskal.flow_step5_desc: LogiKont imports XMLs into isolated schema tenant_{uuid}, balances double-entry entries, and Vertex AI reconciles against bank statement PDFs.
LogikaFiskal.flow_step6_desc: SeKurita logs every transaction in CEF format within AuditLedgerEngine, chaining cryptographic SHA-256 hashes.
LogikaFiskal.section7_title: Licensing Matrix by Client Profile (Bundle or Standalone)
LogikaFiskal.comm_row1_arg: Eliminate manual data entry with AI bank PDF reconciliation, isolate every firm in its own PostgreSQL schema, and safeguard clients' FIEL keys under ISO 27001.
LogikaFiskal.comm_row2_arg: End-to-end fiscal control with automated Anexo 24 and DIOT generation, key custody in Google Cloud KMS, and immutable CEF logs ready for your SIEM.
LogikaFiskal.comm_row3_arg: Integrate bulk SAT extraction without 5004 errors via our REST API, or incorporate our multi-platform cryptographic monorepo (JVM, Ktor, KMP iOS/Android) without coding from scratch.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row1_mech: Strict perimeter M2M authentication (ServiceAuthPlugin with X-Service-Token), idEmpresa-RFC relational lock, and Keycloak RBAC.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row2_mech: NextAuth.js session management using encrypted JWE cookies (HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure) with zero token storage in localStorage.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row3_mech: Dynamic masking and sanitization of personal data (RFC, CURP, credit cards, phones, and emails) across logs with PIISanitizer.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row4_mech: Immutable AuditLedgerEngine in CEF format with SHA-256 hash chaining, quarantine exception (QuarantineException), and instant SOC alerting.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row5_mech: Envelope Encryption (DEK/KEK dual-key architecture) delegated to Google Cloud KMS and AES-256 symmetric cipher in vault_fiel.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row6_mech: Secure coding with Google Tink Streaming AEAD in 1 MB blocks (Zero-OOM) and immediate RAM zeroing via MemoryWiper.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row7_mech: SOAP communication authenticated with FIEL XMLDSig (SHA256withRSA) digital signature and proactive throttling prevention with FlowBD Proxy.
LogikaFiskal.norm_row8_mech: XSD validation and generation of v1.3 XMLs for Chart of Accounts, Trial Balance, and Journal Entries signed with FIEL, plus official DIOT TXT layout.

SeKurita.subtitle: ISO 27001 Cross-Cutting Cybersecurity Framework
SeKurita.tagline: Cryptographic Vault, Anti-OOM Streaming AEAD, RAM Memory Hygiene, and Immutable CEF Audit Ledger
SeKurita.sub_description: Engineered to operate under the most stringent cybersecurity standards without sacrificing performance or leaving keys in memory. Directly embeddable as a binary library (JAR) or multiplatform SDK (iOS/Android).
SeKurita.section1_p1: SeKurita is the advanced information security and regulatory compliance engine designed to operate under the strictest standards of ISO/IEC 27001:2022.
SeKurita.section1_p2: Conceived as a modular suite independent of heavy web frameworks, sekurita-core is packaged as a binary library (JAR) or multiplatform SDK to be directly embedded into microservices, mobile apps (iOS/Android), and financial systems handling highly sensitive data without performance compromise or key exposure in memory.
SeKurita.section2_title: SeKurita Modules: Core, Backend, SDK & Web
SeKurita.mod1_desc: Pure Kotlin cryptographic engine. Implements Google Tink Streaming AEAD, MemoryWiper, and hash-chain audit ledger engine.
SeKurita.mod2_desc: Ktor server with Redis Rate Limiting, circuit breakers, and M2M perimeter authentication gateways.

SeKurita.cap1_purpose: Eliminates OOM crashes from oversized buffers by processing 1 MB blocks with per-segment MAC verification.
SeKurita.cap2_purpose: Destroys symmetric keys and passwords from RAM immediately after use within try-finally blocks.
SeKurita.cap3_purpose: Dual-key architecture (DEK/KEK) delegated to Google Cloud KMS in production or local keys in test suites.

SeKurita.deep_quote: "SeKurita resolves modern software's most critical attack vectors: large-file memory overflows, secrets lingering in RAM, and audit trail tampering."
SeKurita.deep1_desc: Standard Java Cryptography Extension CipherOutputStream buffers entire payloads in the heap when processing heavy files, leading to out-of-memory (OOM) failures. SeKurita implements AesGcmHkdfStreaming in precise 1 MB chunks (CHUNK_SEGMENT_SIZE = 1048576) with independent initialization vectors, halting reads immediately (IOException: Tag mismatch) if a single byte is tampered with.
SeKurita.deep2_desc: In multi-tenant architectures, private keys and passwords residing in RAM represent prime targets for internal attacks and core dump exfiltration. The MemoryWiper engine enforces strict sanitization by overwriting cloned byte arrays with binary zeros (0x00) using secure loops.
SeKurita.deep3_desc: Every event recorded by AuditLedgerEngine mathematically incorporates the hash of the preceding event: Hash_n = SHA-256(Event_n || Hash_{n-1}). If an operator or intruder modifies a single historic entry, the chain breaks, throwing QuarantineException and alerting the SOC instantly.
SeKurita.iso1_impl: Strict M2M perimeter authentication via Ktor gateway demanding X-Service-Token header and centralized RBAC.
SeKurita.iso2_impl: Encrypted JWE cookie session management (HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure) without client-side token exposure.
SeKurita.iso3_impl: Automated PII sanitization (tax IDs, cards, phones, emails) in logs via PIISanitizer.
SeKurita.iso4_impl: Immutable CEF-formatted ledger with SHA-256 hash chaining and automated quarantine triggers.
SeKurita.iso5_impl: Envelope Encryption (DEK/KEK) backed by Google Cloud KMS and AES-256 symmetric cipher for secret vaults.
SeKurita.iso6_impl: 1 MB Google Tink Streaming AEAD (Zero-OOM) and strict RAM clearing with MemoryWiper.
SeKurita.b2b1_desc: Embed sekurita-core directly into your JVM, Spring Boot, or Ktor backend without external service dependencies. Also available as a Kotlin Multiplatform SDK for mobile apps.
SeKurita.b2b2_desc: Deploy vault services and Rate Limiting via Docker Compose with native support for Redis and encrypted PostgreSQL, ready for banking-grade production.
